title: MPX EncounterPlus V5 Item
description: A compendium item authored directly as a project file.

id.markdownDescription: *Required.* Persistent UUID of the item. Keep this value unchanged once the item has been used in a build.
id.patternErrorMessage: The item id must be a valid UUID.

slug.markdownDescription: *Required.* Stable text identifier without accents or spaces. Separate words with hyphens. Each content item in the module must use a different slug.
slug.patternErrorMessage: The slug must contain only lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens (no spaces, accents, or uppercase).

attributes.markdownDescription: *Optional.* Measurement system and ruleset this item's values are written for.

measurement.markdownDescription:
*Optional.* Measurement system used for weight and distance values.

Possible values: `""` (default), `"metric"`, `"imperial"`.

ruleset.markdownDescription:
*Optional.* Ruleset this item's data follows.

Possible values: `""` (default), `"5e"`, `"5.5e"`.

data.markdownDescription: *Optional.* Item statistics. Every field is itself optional — delete any that don't apply to this item.

type.markdownDescription:
*Optional.* Item type, used to pick which of the fields below apply.

Possible values: `""` (default), `"custom"`, `"armor"`, `"weapon"`, `"lightArmor"`, `"mediumArmor"`, `"heavyArmor"`, `"shield"`, `"meleeWeapon"`, `"rangedWeapon"`, `"ammunition"`, `"rod"`, `"staff"`, `"wand"`, `"potion"`, `"ring"`, `"scroll"`, `"wondrousItem"`, `"adventuringGear"`, `"wealth"`, `"gemstone"`, `"tool"`, `"poison"`, `"instrument"`, `"arcaneFocus"`, `"holySymbol"`, `"mount"`, `"equipmentPack"`, `"tradeGood"`, `"druidicFocus"`, `"vehicleLand"`, `"vehicleWater"`, `"vehicleSpace"`.

typeDetail.markdownDescription: *Optional.* Free-text detail shown for armor and weapon types (e.g. the specific weapon or armor name).

attunement.markdownDescription:
*Optional.* Whether the item requires attunement.

Possible values: `true` or `false` (default).

attunementDetail.markdownDescription: *Optional.* Free-text attunement requirement, shown when `attunement` is `true`.

weight.markdownDescription: *Optional.* Item weight, in the unit set by `attributes.measurement`.

ac.markdownDescription: *Optional.* Armor class, for armor and shield types.

stealth.markdownDescription:
*Optional.* Whether wearing this armor gives disadvantage on Stealth checks.

Possible values: `true` or `false` (default).

str.markdownDescription: *Optional.* Minimum Strength score required to wear this armor without penalty.

properties.markdownDescription:
*Optional.* Weapon properties.

Possible values: `"ammunition"`, `"finesse"`, `"heavy"`, `"light"`, `"loading"`, `"range"`, `"reach"`, `"special"`, `"thrown"`, `"twoHanded"`, `"versatile"`, `"cleave"`, `"graze"`, `"nick"`, `"push"`, `"sap"`, `"slow"`, `"topple"`, `"vex"`.

Example: `["finesse", "thrown"]`

Empty: `[]`

dmg2.markdownDescription: *Optional.* Versatile damage dice, shown when `properties` includes `"versatile"`.

container.markdownDescription:
*Optional.* Whether this item can hold other items.

Possible values: `true` or `false` (default).

capacity.markdownDescription: *Optional.* Carrying capacity, in the unit set by `attributes.measurement`, shown when `container` is `true`. Leave at `0` for unlimited.

image.markdownDescription: *Optional.* Path to the item's image, relative to the project root. Save the image directly inside the `items` folder at the project root.
image.patternErrorMessage: The image path must point to a file stored directly inside the project's items folder.

sources.markdownDescription:
*Optional.* Sourcebook references for this item.

Example: `[{ "name": "Player's Handbook", "page": 12 }]`

Empty: `[]`

tags.markdownDescription:
*Optional.* Array of keywords used to describe and find the item.

Example: `["magic", "rare"]`

Empty: `[]`
